what: a grey ashen draught: a small squat bottle shaped like a cube, as wide as it is tall, with four flat sides, sharp corners and flat square shoulders, and a short narrow neck in the middle of the top, like an old ink bottle. It is filled with flat, chalky, opaque pale grey liquid, the grey of cold wood ash, with a darker grey sediment settled in a layer at the bottom. It is stopped with a round peg of pale grey stone. The glass is thick and the vessel is full nearly to the top, so the whole of it shows the strong colour of what is inside; nothing can be seen through it and the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Flat chalky pale ash grey, a darker grey layer at the bottom, a dull white glint on one corner, a pale grey stone peg.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: squat cube-shaped bottle with a short neck

what: a stormy grey vial: a glass vial shaped like a tall narrow pyramid with four flat sides: a square flat base and straight sides leaning in to a small neck at the top, three times as tall as its base is wide. Inside it churn dark storm clouds: dark slate-grey and charcoal billows, heavy and rolling, with paler grey edges on each cloud, filling it from bottom to top. It is closed with a dull heavy cap of grey lead, crimped round the neck. The glass is thick and the vessel is full nearly to the top, so the whole of it shows the strong colour of what is inside; nothing can be seen through it and the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Dark slate-grey and charcoal storm clouds with paler grey cloud edges, a dull mid-grey lead cap.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: a jar of foul grey ooze: a low, wide glass jar, a shallow drum twice as wide as it is tall, with thick walls and a thick rim, and no neck and no lid. It is brim-full of thick, smooth, heavy grey ooze exactly the colour of wet cement, a plain colourless mid-grey with paler grey highlights and charcoal folds, which heaps up above the rim in a sagging mound and slumps over the rim on the left side in one fat sluggish tongue that hangs half way down the outside of the jar. The glass is thick and the vessel is full nearly to the top, so the whole of it shows the strong colour of what is inside; nothing can be seen through it and the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Plain colourless mid-grey ooze like wet cement, paler grey highlights, charcoal-grey folds, thick pale grey glass.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: low wide jar, wider than tall
dull grey ooze heaped above the rim
one fat tongue of ooze slumping over the side

what: a smoky black vial: a small, narrow vial like a thick test tube, a straight tube with a rounded bottom, three times as tall as it is wide, of glossy black glass. Inside the black glass coils thick smoke: two bold curling ribbons of pale grey smoke wind up through the blackness from bottom to top, plain to see. A sharp pale grey line of light runs down the vial's whole left edge. It is closed with a bright cap of polished pewter, pale silver-grey, with a domed top.
colours: Glossy black glass, two bold pale grey ribbons of smoke inside, a pale grey lit edge, a bright pale pewter cap.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: narrow straight tube vial with a rounded bottom
black with pale grey smoke coiling inside
